name: Tensho
description: A kata that emphasizes circular movements and soft techniques, representing the 'ju' aspect of Goju-Ryu.

origin.title: Origin
origin.content: Tensho was developed by Chōjun Miyagi as a complement to Sanchin.

transmission.title: Transmission au Goju-Ryu
transmission.content: This kata was passed down through the Goju-Ryu lineage.

historicalDevelopment.title: Historical Development and Variations
historicalDevelopment.content: The kata has maintained its core structure while allowing for minor variations between schools.

technicalFeatures.title: Technical and Philosophical Features
technicalFeatures.content: A kata that emphasizes circular movements and soft techniques, representing the 'ju' aspect of Goju-Ryu.

controversy.title: Controverses/variations au sein du Goju-Ryu
controversy.content: There are minor variations in timing and emphasis between different Goju-Ryu schools.

relationships.title: Relationship to other kata/Systems
relationships.content: This kata is part of the Goju-Ryu curriculum.

modernPractice.title: Utilisation dans la pratique moderne
modernPractice.content: This kata is used to develop techniques and understanding in Goju-Ryu training.
